verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robot simulator. A data-to-training-to-fleet-deployment pipeline is a plausible question for robotics development tools, but the evidence shows no such capability. Gazebo documents generating simulated sensor data, plugins, and transport messaging. None of these cover ingesting collected robot data into model training or deploying improved models to a fleet; synthetic sensor generation is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can feed collected robot data into model training and deploy the improved model back to the fleet
